manual_checklist.title: CVI certifying statement: New World Screwworm freedom
manual_checklist.detail: All animals requiring a CVI (Certificate of Veterinary Inspection) for importation into Hawaii must have a certifying statement: "All animals were inspected and found free of evidence of New World Screwworm infestation."

manual_checklist.title: Apply online via HIPOP
manual_checklist.detail: Submit your dog or cat's entry application online through HIPOP (https://hipop.ais.hawaii.gov/), with the required documents uploaded and the applicable fee paid by card, ahead of arrival — see the arrival-airport deadlines below.

manual_checklist.title: Document deadline depends on your arrival airport
manual_checklist.detail: Landing at Honolulu: your HIPOP application and documents must be submitted no less than 10 days before your pet arrives in Hawai'i to qualify for the 5-Day-Or-Less or Airport Release programs (late submission means a higher fee — $244 instead of $185 for airport release, $130 instead of $98 for re-entry). Landing at Kona, Kahului, or Līhu'e (neighbor islands): submit 30 days or more ahead of your pet's planned arrival instead.

manual_checklist.title: Two rabies vaccinations in the pet's lifetime
manual_checklist.detail: Hawaii requires original certificates for 2 rabies vaccinations in the pet's lifetime, the most recent given more than 30 days before arrival and still in-date. Each certificate must be signed in ink by a licensed veterinarian, and must list: vaccine name, lot or serial number, booster interval, vaccination date, and vaccine lot expiration date.

manual_checklist.title: OIE-FAVN titer timing: arrive 30 days–36 months after the lab receives the sample
manual_checklist.detail: The clock starts the day the approved lab RECEIVES the blood sample, not the draw or result date. Too early (under 30 days) or too late (over 36 months) means quarantine.

manual_checklist.title: Health certificate within 14 days of arrival
manual_checklist.detail: A licensed vet must examine the pet and issue an ORIGINAL health certificate no more than 14 days before arrival — a photocopy is not acceptable. This is mandatory for the direct-release program.

manual_checklist.title: Tick treatment within 14 days of arrival, recorded on the certificate
manual_checklist.detail: A tick treatment must be given within 14 days of arrival and recorded on the health certificate. Revolution® is NOT an acceptable product for this treatment.
